instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Regional supermarket chain operating 28 stores across central and northern Portugal, specializing in high-quality private-label groceries. The company manages a complex supply chain involving perishable goods sourced both locally and internationally, requiring meticulous inventory control and rapid response to market shifts. As a micro-retailer, efficiency is paramount due to extremely thin margins and the need for localized sourcing compliance.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully deployed a new CRM system across the sales team 18 months ago, which improved lead tracking and reduced pipeline data entry time by 30%. Building on this success, we are now actively exploring marketing automation integration and AI-assisted demand forecasting. Furthermore, initial pilot programs have tested basic digital self-checkout kiosks to improve in-store transaction speed.
answers.strategicGoals: Customer retention has declined from 92% to 84% over the past 18 months, primarily among our mid-tier and enterprise segments. Exit interviews consistently cite product stagnation and poor digital self-service tools as reasons for leaving. We need to urgently modernize our customer-facing technology and proactively address the specific pain points driving churn before the trend becomes irreversible.
answers.additionalContext: The competitive landscape includes large national chains leveraging economies of scale and emerging quick-commerce solutions, requiring Crest Capital to innovate quickly on service and logistics.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role—innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.

opportunities.title: Enhance Self-Service Experience via AI Chatbots
opportunities.rationale: Addressing customer feedback regarding poor digital self-service is a direct defense mechanism against churn. Implementing an AI chatbot can provide instant, 24/7 answers to common product and ordering questions, reducing the burden on limited staff.

first_actions: Select and integrate a low-cost NLP service (e.g., Dialogflow).
Pilot deployment on the main website.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce customer support ticket volume related to FAQs by 15% within 3 months.
milestones: Q1: Pilot launch and feature testing complete (Month 1)
Q2: Full rollout across all key channels (Month 3)

opportunities.title: Hyper-Local Micro-Fulfillment Network (Market Defense)
opportunities.rationale: Given the high competitive pressure, investing in a proprietary micro-fulfillment network allows Crest Capital to bypass the long lead times and high overhead of large competitors. This radical shift focuses on maximizing 'freshness' and speed within a tight geographic radius, creating an insurmountable local moat.

first_actions: Conduct market analysis on competitor delivery zones.
Secure partnerships with 3 local third-party logistics (3PL) providers.
Develop a lean operational model for decentralized inventory stocking.
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase local customer retention rate by 5 percentage points within the pilot zone.
milestones: Q1: Finalize 3PL contracts and operational blueprint (Month 2)
Q3: Launch first hyper-local delivery pilot program (Month 6)

opportunities.title: Predictive Waste Reduction Engine Refinement
opportunities.rationale: Since the company is already evaluating AI for demand forecasting, this incremental step focuses on refining that model to specifically target high-value perishables. Improving waste reduction directly impacts the 35% private-label revenue share and operational costs.

first_actions: Integrate real-time inventory data with weather patterns and local event schedules.
Fine-tune ML models using historical sales data for perishable goods.
Establish a monthly 'waste reduction' KPI review cycle.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce fresh produce waste by an additional 8% within 12 months.
milestones: Q2: Model refinement and integration complete (Month 4)
Q3: Operational review of waste metrics vs. baseline (Month 7)

next_steps.action: Establish a dedicated, albeit part-time, Innovation Steering Committee.
Begin detailed feasibility study for the Hyper-Local Micro-Fulfillment Network (Radical Opportunity #2).
Implement the AI Chatbot pilot to address immediate customer pain points.

key_weaknesses: Lack of formalized R&D process, leading to ad-hoc prototyping and inconsistent innovation output.
High operational dependency on a very small team, resulting in chronic resource scarcity for non-essential strategic initiatives.
Partial digital maturity (Level 2) which creates immediate vulnerability against digitally native competitors.
